prior_year_events.impact_description: Balance on Technical Account before investment return of 2,574 $'000

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a total prior year reserve release of $6.524 million for the 2016 calendar year, representing a 14.87% release of opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was primarily driven by a surplus from the closed years 2007-2013 and profits generated by the 2014 and 2015 accounts. The 2014 account produced a profit of $1.7 million, while the 2015 account contributed a profit of $2.574 million to the technical account balance.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development is derived from the 'Balance on Technical Account before investment return' for prior years (2014 and 2015 accounts) as presented in the 'Results' table on page 2, which represents the profit/loss contribution of those years to the current calendar year result. The claims development triangle is a loss ratio triangle, not an absolute claims amount triangle.
